excerpt: Vivo Y32 5G has been unveiled with a Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 processor, a 6.87-inch 120Hz display and an 8,000mAh battery. The smartphone supports 44W fast charging, reverse charging and microSD storage expansion of up to 2TB.
paragraph1: Vivo Y32 5G has been unveiled with a Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 processor, a 6.87-inch 120Hz display and an 8,000mAh battery. The smartphone supports 44W fast charging, reverse charging and microSD storage expansion of up to 2TB.Vivo Y32 5G has been unveiled with a Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 processor.Vivo on Monday unveiled the Y32 5G, a new smartphone that brings 5G connectivity alongside an 8,000mAh battery and expandable storage. The smartphone is being launched as the 5G version of the Vivo Y32 4G and retains most of its hardware specifications. It runs on Qualcomm's Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 processor, and the company will not provide any information on its price or availability.
paragraph2: The Vivo Y32 5G comes with a large LCD display, a 120Hz refresh rate and 44W wired charging. One of the major features is its massive battery, which Vivo claims provides up to 37 hours of local video playback on a single charge. The phone also supports reverse charging, allowing users to power other devices using its battery.Vivo Y32 5G specifications and featuresVivo Y32 5G has a 6.87 LCD with a 120 Hz refresh rate. It is powered under the hood by the Qualcomm Snapdragon 4 Gen 2, a low-end 5G SoC released in 2023. For comparison, the 4G variant uses the Unisoc T7300 processor.
paragraph3: The smartphone comes in one variant with 6GB of RAM and 128GB of built-in storage. Users can also expand the storage up to 2TB via the microSD card slot.Vivo Y32 5G camera and battery detailsIt has a dual rear camera unit with a 50 MP primary sensor and a 2 MP secondary sensor. It has an 8 MP selfie and video camera for selfies and video calls.It has an 8,000 mAh cell with 44 W charging capability. According to Vivo, it can deliver up to 37 hours of local video playback. It also has reverse charging capabilities, enabling users to charge compatible accessories and other devices.
paragraph4: Vivo Y32 5G connectivity and availabilityConnectivity options include Wi-Fi 5 and dual SIM in the Vivo Y32 5G. It also has IP68 and IP69 dust and water resistance ratings.The smartphone will be available in two colour options, as shown in Vivo's promotional images. The company hasn't officially announced pricing or a sale date, though.With its entry-level pricing and Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset, the Vivo Y32 5G can be expected to compete in the budget smartphone market. Details of pricing and market availability are awaited.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing.
paragraph5: She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.

title: Google just rolled out the Android backup feature we’ve been waiting for all year
title_bn: গুগল সবেমাত্র অ্যান্ড্রয়েড ব্যাকআপ ফিচার চালু করেছে যার জন্য আমরা সারা বছর অপেক্ষা করেছি।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Google's November Play Services release lists automatic photo and video backup from Android to Windows via Quick Share.
paragraph1: Joe Maring / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Google’s latest system release notes list automatic photo and video backup from Android phones to Windows PCs via Quick Share. The feature arrives with Google Play services v26.43, but these updates roll out gradually, so you may not see it right away. Our earlier teardowns suggested Samsung phones and PCs won’t be supported, at least at first.
paragraph2: Google has been quietly building a way to automatically back up your phone’s photos and videos to your PC without touching the cloud, and it looks like that tool is finally ready for prime time.In its System Services release notes for November 2026, Google lists automatic backup of photos and videos from Android to Windows using Quick Share as part of Google Play services v26.43.The entry sits under the Device Connectivity section and is tagged for both phones and PCs.
paragraph3: It’s a short line with no further details, but it’s the first time Google has officially acknowledged a feature we’ve been following for months.We first spotted the “Automatic backup” option hiding in Quick Share settings back in April, where it promised to copy photos, videos, and audio from your phone to a PC on your home network. In July, we found evidence that Google planned to exclude Samsung phones from the feature, and our most recent teardown in October showed that restriction expanding to Samsung PCs as well.That October teardown also gave us a good idea of how setup should work.
paragraph4: Based on strings in Google Play services, you’ll start the process from the Quick Share for Windows app, keeping your phone nearby and both devices signed in to the same Google Account. After that, Quick Share should automatically save your photos and videos to your PC, without needing any cables or cloud subscription.Google’s release notes don’t mention any Samsung restrictions, so we’ll have to wait and see whether those exclusions carry over to the final release.If you’re eager to try out the new feature, keep in mind that Google Play services updates roll out gradually, so it could take some time before the feature reaches your phone, even after the update lands.
paragraph5: You’ll also want to make sure the Quick Share app on your Windows PC is up to date.
bangla_paragraph1: জো ম্যারিং / অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষ গুগলে অ্যান্ড্ৰয়েড প্রশাসক যুক্ত করুনঃ TL; DR গুগলের সর্বশেষ সিস্টেম রিলিজ নোটগুলি দ্রুত ভাগ করে নেওয়ার মাধ্যমে অ্যান্ড্রেড ফোন থেকে উইন্ডোজ পিসিতে স্বয়ংক্রিয় ফটো এবং ভিডিও ব্যাকআপ তালিকাভুক্ত করে। এই বৈশিষ্ট্যটি গুগল প্লে পরিষেবা v26.43 এর সাথে আসে, তবে এই আপডেটগুলি ধীরে ধীরে রোল আউট হয়, তাই আপনি এটি অবিলম্বে দেখতে পাবেন না। আমাদের পূর্ববর্তী টিয়ারডাউনগুলি পরামর্শ দিয়েছে যে স্যামসাং ফোন এবং পিসিগুলি সমর্থন করবে না, অন্তত প্রথমে।
bangla_paragraph2: গুগল নীরবে আপনার ফোনের ছবি এবং ভিডিওগুলিকে আপনার পিসিতে স্পর্শ না করে স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে ব্যাকআপ করার একটি উপায় তৈরি করছে এবং দেখে মনে হচ্ছে যে এই সরঞ্জামটি অবশেষে প্রধান সময়ের জন্য প্রস্তুত। ২০২৬ সালের নভেম্বরের জন্য তার সিস্টেম পরিষেবাগুলির রিলিজ নোটগুলিতে গুগলের দ্রুত ভাগ করে নেওয়ার মাধ্যমে অ্যান্ড্রয়েড থেকে উইন্ডোজ পর্যন্ত ফটো এবং ভিডিওগুলির স্বয়ংক্রিত ব্যাক আপ তালিকাভুক্ত করা হয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph3: এটি একটি সংক্ষিপ্ত লাইন, তবে আরও বিস্তারিত নেই, তবে এটি প্রথমবারের মতো গুগল আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে এমন একটি বৈশিষ্ট্যকে স্বীকৃতি দিয়েছে যা আমরা কয়েক মাস ধরে অনুসরণ করছি। আমরা প্রথমবার অটোমেটিক ব্যাকআপ বিকল্পটি দ্রুত ভাগ করে নেওয়ার সেটিংসে লুকিয়ে দেখেছি এপ্রিল মাসে, যেখানে এটি আপনার ফোন থেকে ফটো, ভিডিও এবং অডিও অনুলিপি করার প্রতিশ্রুতি দিয়েছিল আপনার হোম নেটওয়ার্কের পিসিতে। জুলাই মাসে আমরা প্রমাণ পেয়েছি যে গুগলের এই বৈশিষ্ট্য থেকে স্যামসাং ফোনগুলি বাদ দেওয়ার পরিকল্পনা ছিল, এবং অক্টোবরে আমাদের সর্বশেষ ধ্বংস দেখিয়েছিল যে সীমাবদ্ধতা প্রসারিত হচ্ছে
bangla_paragraph4: গুগল প্লে পরিষেবাগুলির স্ট্রিংগুলির উপর ভিত্তি করে, আপনি উইন্ডোজ অ্যাপ্লিকেশনটির জন্য দ্রুত ভাগ করে নেওয়ার মাধ্যমে প্রক্রিয়াটি শুরু করবেন, আপনার ফোনটি কাছাকাছি রাখবেন এবং উভয় ডিভাইস একই গুগলের অ্যাকাউন্টে সাইন ইন করবে। এর পরে, দ্রুত ভাগ করা আপনার ফটো এবং ভিডিওগুলিকে স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপনার পিসিতে সংরক্ষণ করবে, কোনও তারের বা ক্লাউড সাবস্ক্রিপশনের প্রয়োজন ছাড়াই। গুগলে রিলিজ নোটগুলিতে কোনও স্যামসাং বিধিনিষেধের উল্লেখ নেই, তাই আমাদের অপেক্ষা করতে হবে এবং দেখতে হবে যে এই বহিষ্কারগুলি চূড়ান্ত রিলিজে স্থানান্তরিত হয় কিনা।
bangla_paragraph5: আপনি আপনার উইন্ডোজ পিসিতে দ্রুত শেয়ার অ্যাপটি আপডেট করা আছে কিনা তাও নিশ্চিত করতে চান।

title: Big ticket tech deals needed to keep pace with AI growth boom, financial leaders say
title_bn: এআই বৃদ্ধির গতি ধরে রাখতে বড় টিকিট প্রযুক্তির চুক্তি প্রয়োজন, আর্থিক নেতারা বলছেন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: HONGKONG-FINANCIALS-SUMMIT:Big ticket tech deals needed to keep pace with AI growth boom, financial leaders say
paragraph1: By Kane Wu and Selena LiHONG KONG, Nov 3 (Reuters) - Tech companies will need to deliver more big ticket fundraisings deals to help meet the enormous demand for capital required by a growth boom in the AI industry, global financial leaders said on Tuesday.Tech stocks globally have faced pressure in recent weeks as growing concerns about AI spending trigger a new wave of selloffs, with combined spending set to exceed $730 billion this year, up from about $700 billion.Most of the major tech companies were expected to raise more capital to keep up with the enormous likely demand from the AI industry's growth, said Jon Gray, president of Blackstone, which is an active investor in AI infrastructure."Now you're in an environment where the demand's running well ahead of supply," Gray said at an investment gathering in Hong Kong, citing "pretty extraordinary" demand for computing power."So that gives me a lot of comfort," he added. "Meta and Google and Oracle raising equity ...
paragraph2: SpaceX going public, Anthropic going public," Gray said."On top of it ... the data centers, the energy needs are enormous."STRONG COMPANIES WITH 'GOOD STORIES'Despite some AI-related market upheavals, strong companies with "good stories" would still be able to raise capital, though the industry's strong growth could create volatility for investors, said Goldman Sachs Chief Executive David Solomon."But things will go wrong too, and we'll get things wrong," he added at the event, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority's Global Financial Leaders' Investment Summit."Investors will find situations where they pick wrong, where they lose money ...
paragraph3: It's important to have a balanced, diversified view."Morgan Stanley Chief Executive Ted Pick flagged emerging early signs of U.S markets edging close to a correction, with a majority of stocks in major indices off nearly 10%.The latest test of investor appetite is a sale €6 billion ($6.7 billion) in bonds on Monday by Google parent Alphabet.ASIA-PAC TECH FUNDRAISING MORE THAN TRIPLEDFundraising by Asia-Pacific tech companies more than tripled to $125.
paragraph4: 8 billion in the first three quarters of 2026 from $36 billion a year earlier.The growth was driven by a wave of semiconductor and AI-related deals, such as Chinese chipmakers CXMT’s $9.8-billion IPO and Enflame Technology's $910.6-million listing, LSEG data shows.Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft and Meta have signalled that spending on AI will not slow.In ‌one of the largest debt deals tied to the AI buildout,Blackstone agreed last week to provide financing of $63 ​billion with Bank of America, Citi and Morgan Stanley to buy Broadcom's AI chips and networking gear for Anthropic.
paragraph5: The rising cost of capital and some of today's scepticism will slow the pace, however, Gray added."But the overall trend is towards greater investment and therefore more needs for multiple forms of capital."Emanuel Roman, CEO of asset manager PIMCO, said AI financing deals are attractive, with more coming for the firm.
bangla_paragraph1: কান উ এবং সেলেনা লিহং কং, ৩ নভেম্বর (রয়টার্স) - এআই শিল্পের বৃদ্ধির কারণে প্রয়োজনীয় মূলধনের বিশাল চাহিদা মেটাতে প্রযুক্তি সংস্থাগুলিকে আরও বড় টিকিট তহবিল সংগ্রহের চুক্তি করতে হবে, বিশ্বব্যাপী আর্থিক নেতারা মঙ্গলবার বলেছেন। এআই ব্যয় সম্পর্কে ক্রমবর্ধমান উদ্বেগগুলি নতুন বিক্রয়কে ট্রিগার করার কারণে সাম্প্রতিক সপ্তাহগুলিতে বিশ্বব্যাপি প্রযুক্তি শেয়ারের উপর চাপ পড়েছে।
bangla_paragraph2: স্পেসএক্স পাবলিক, অ্যানথ্রপিক পাবলিক হচ্ছে", গ্রে বলেন। "এর উপরে ... ডাটা সেন্টার, শক্তির চাহিদা বিশাল।"এআই-সম্পর্কিত কিছু বাজারের বিপর্যয় সত্ত্বেও, শক্তিশালী সংস্থাগুলি "ভাল গল্প" নিয়ে এখনও মূলধন সংগ্রহ করতে সক্ষম হবে, যদিও শিল্পের শক্তিশালী বৃদ্ধি বিনিয়োগকারীদের জন্য অস্থিরতা সৃষ্টি করতে পারে, গোল্ডম্যান স্যাক্সের প্রধান নির্বাহী ডেভিড সলোমন বলেছেন।
bangla_paragraph3: এটি একটি সুষম, বৈচিত্র্যময় দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি থাকা গুরুত্বপূর্ণ। "মর্গান স্ট্যানলির প্রধান নির্বাহী টেড পিক মার্কিন বাজারের সংশোধন ঘনিষ্ঠ হওয়ার প্রাথমিক লক্ষণগুলি চিহ্নিত করেছেন, প্রধান সূচকগুলির বেশিরভাগ স্টক প্রায় 10% হ্রাস পেয়েছে। বিনিয়োগকারীদের ক্ষুধা সর্বশেষ পরীক্ষার জন্য সোমবার গুগলের মূল সংস্থা আলফাবেটের দ্বারা 6 বিলিয়ন ইউরো ($ 6.7 বিলিয়ন) এর বন্ড বিক্রি করা হয়েছে।এশিয়া-প্যাসিফিক টেক ফান্ডারাইজিং ত্রিগুণেরও বেশিএশিিয়া-পাসফিক প্রযুক্তি সংস্থাগুলির তহবিল সংগ্রহের পরিমাণ 125 ডলারে তিনগুণের বেশি বেড়েছে।
bangla_paragraph4: ২০২৬ সালের প্রথম তিন ত্রৈমাসিকের মধ্যে এই প্রবৃদ্ধি ৩৬ বিলিয়ন ডলার থেকে বেড়েছে। এই প্রবণতা অর্ধপরিবাহী এবং এআই-সংক্রান্ত চুক্তির একটি তরঙ্গের দ্বারা চালিত হয়েছিল, যেমন চীনা চিপ নির্মাতারা সিএক্সএমটি এর ৯.৮ বিলিয়ন ডলারের আইপিও এবং এনফ্লেম টেকনোলজির ৯১০.৬ মিলিয়ন ডলারের তালিকাভুক্তকরণ, এলএসইজি তথ্য দেখায়। আলফাবেট, অ্যামাজন, মাইক্রোসফট এবং মেটা ইঙ্গিত দিয়েছে যে এআইয়ের উপর ব্যয় হ্রাস পাবে না। এআই বিল্ডডাউনের সাথে যুক্ত বৃহত্তম ঋণ চুক্তির মধ্যে একটিতে,ব্ল্যাকস্টোন গত সপ্তাহে ব্যাংক অফ আমেরিকার সাথে ৬৩ বিলিয়ন মার্কিন ডলার অর্থায়ন প্রদানের জন্য সম্মত হয়েছিল।
bangla_paragraph5: মূলধনের ব্যয় বৃদ্ধি এবং আজকের কিছু সংশয়বাদ গতি কমিয়ে দেবে, তবে গ্রে যোগ করেছেন। "কিন্তু সামগ্রিক প্রবণতা বৃহত্তর বিনিয়োগের দিকে এবং তাই একাধিক ধরণের মূলধন প্রয়োজনের দিকে। "অ্যাসেট ম্যানেজার পিআইএমসিওর প্রধান নির্বাহী ইম্যানুয়েল রোমান বলেছেন, এআই অর্থায়ন চুক্তি আকর্ষণীয়, আরও বেশি আসছে।

paragraph1: Ukraine-based CODE380 has developed the D·Vision SDR, a 280-gram receiver that intercepts live camera feeds from Russian drones in real time. The device scans frequencies between 500 MHz and 8.7 GHz, helping Ukrainian forces monitor drone movements and identify potential targets before attacks.Ukraine-based CODE380 has developed the D·Vision SDR.(AI generated image for representational purposes only)Ukraine's Kyiv-based communications equipment startup CODE380 has developed a pocket-sized receiver that can intercept live camera feeds from Russian drones, allowing Ukrainian military units to monitor incoming threats before they strike. The device, known as the D·Vision SDR, can detect radio frequencies transmitted by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and display them on a screen, helping the operator determine a drone's direction and target.The receiver weighs about 280 grams (10 ounces) and can detect a larger spectrum of drone signals than a few other competing devices. According to a 2 November report by Defense News, the technology could improve battlefield surveillance by allowing Ukrainian forces to passively monitor unencrypted video transmissions without broadcasting signals that might reveal their positions. D·Vision SDR can detect drone signals across multiple frequencies Created by CODE380, the D·Vision SDR is a software-defined radio that scans frequencies from 500 MHz to 8.
paragraph2: 7 GHz. The system takes in incoming signals and outputs video feeds to the viewer, and its software design allows it to be updated to accommodate new drone specifications, according to the publication.The receiver can scan without blind spots across its frequency range and provides better sensitivity, the developers told DOU, a news platform for software developers and IT specialists in Ukraine, on 17 October. According to Militarnyi, it can transmit analogue video signals over distances of up to 10 kilometres within a frequency range of 540 MHz to 6 GHz. At higher frequencies, its detection range drops to about 3.5-5 kilometres.The device can monitor video feeds from Russia's Molniya drones One of the receiver's main features is that it covers the frequency range of 4.1 GHz to 4.5 GHz.
paragraph3: In June, Russian Molniya strike drones were reportedly starting to send video feeds over this range.Serhii 'Flash' Beskrestnov, a radio specialist and adviser to Ukraine's president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, highlighted the issue in a Facebook post in June. He cautioned that many current drone detectors are not sensitive to these frequencies, which could leave dangerous blind spots.Unlike active detection systems, the D·Vision SDR works passively. This enables it to receive messages from drones without transmitting messages that could expose the location of Ukrainian units. Lighter than competing Ukrainian drone detectors The D·Vision SDR is much lighter than a couple of other Ukrainian-built receivers. Babai's Vydun 7.5 weighs approximately 900 g, as specified by the manufacturer, while Contra-drone's SENSE-4 weighs approximately 600 g. BlueBird Tech's Chuyka 3.
paragraph4: 0 weighs up to 650 g.At around 280 g, CODE380's receiver may help drone operators carry more detection gear on missions.Digital drone feeds could challenge interception technologyHowever, the technology has its drawbacks. Many of the current receivers don't work well with encrypted digital video or fibre-optic drones, and some signals are out of range.Beskrestnov has also cautioned that, in the future, Russia may increasingly shift to digital video transmission, making its analogue receivers less effective. In August 2026, The New York Times reported that some Russian Molniya drones were using artificial intelligence systems powered by Nvidia chips and could operate without emitting detectable radio signals.This will eventually make passive receivers, like D·Vision SDR, less effective, and the need for Ukraine to constantly improve its drone detection capabilities is clear.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing. title: Google takes Dreambeans to India in bid to bring AI-generated personal stories to the masses
title_bn: Google takes Dreambeans to India in bid to bring AI-generated personal stories to the masses
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Google's Dreambeans, its latest AI experiment, now supports 13 Indian languages.
paragraph1: Google has launched its experimental AI app Dreambeans in India, its first market outside the U.S., as the company looks to tap the world’s second-largest internet market to bring personalized visual stories drawn from users’ digital activity to a broader audience. On Monday, Google expanded Dreambeans, available on Android and iOS, to India with support for 13 local languages, including Hindi, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, and Bengali, alongside English. The launch comes less than two months after Google made the app available to all eligible U.S. users aged 18 and older. Introduced in June, Google’s Dreambeans uses information from connected Google services, including Calendar, Gemini, Gmail, Photos, Search, and YouTube, to proactively generate personalized, illustrated stories about users’ interests and everyday lives, without requiring them to enter a prompt. The app initially featured static, AI-generated illustrations, but Google recently added a feature that uses its Veo video-generation model to even animate images in select stories.
paragraph2: Google said it chose India as Dreambeans’ first international market because of strong interest from Indian users seeking access to the app and the widespread use of its services in the country. India stood out for its high overlap of users across Gemini, Gmail, and Google Photos, Google product manager Gozde Oznur said during a press briefing. Dreambeans has recorded nearly 55,000 downloads in the U.S. since its June debut, according to estimates from market intelligence firm Sensor Tower shared with TechCrunch. About 63% of those downloads came in September, when Google opened the app to all eligible U.S. users aged 18 and older. However, downloads dropped 84% month over month to about 5,500 in October.
paragraph3: In the first 30 days after Google opened Dreambeans to all eligible U.S. users, the app recorded an estimated 29,000 downloads, compared with 7.4 million for Meta’s Muse, 2.8 million for ChatGPT, 362,000 for Grok Bot, and 155,000 for Claude during their respective first 30 days after launch, Sensor Tower estimates show. However, unlike those general-purpose AI apps, Dreambeans focuses on generating personalized stories instead of responding to a broad range of user queries. Even though Dreambeans supports many widely spoken Indian languages, users can select only one language at a time for their generated stories. The app can draw on information across Google services in multiple languages, but it cannot currently generate stories that mix languages, Oznur said during the briefing. That could limit Dreambeans’ appeal in India, where many people regularly switch between languages, including Hindi and English, often mixing the two in what is commonly known as Hinglish.
paragraph4: Dreambeans’ dependence on information from users’ Google accounts also raises questions about privacy and data access. The app uses Google’s Personal Intelligence technology to draw on connected services and personalize its AI-generated stories. Those services can contain sensitive personal information that some users may not want to share with an AI app just to receive personalized content. Users can choose which Google services to connect to Dreambeans and disconnect them at any time, Oznur said. They can also delete their Dreambeans data from within the app. Moreover, Oznur asserted that information deleted from the underlying connected services is also removed from Dreambeans’ personalization system. Users, Oznur said, can tell Dreambeans to avoid certain subjects, including business-related information, and the app will try to adjust its stories accordingly. She added that Dreambeans is available only to personal Gmail account holders, not enterprise users, and that generated stories are visible only to the account holder. Dreambeans’ proactive approach also carries the risk of surfacing memories that users may find upsetting.
paragraph5: Oznur acknowledged that Dreambeans could generate stories involving people who have died, for instance. She said users can tell the app to stop showing certain subjects, comparing the feature to controls in Google Photos that let users limit which memories appear. Oznur told reporters that Google is exploring ways to make Dreambeans more actionable, moving beyond personalized stories and recommendations to help users act on the app’s suggestions. title: Galaxy S27 Ultra goes head-to-head with Pixel 11 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro, and S26 Ultra in new leak
title_bn: Galaxy S27 Ultra goes head-to-head with Pixel 11 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro, and S26 Ultra in new leak
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Here's how Samsung's next "Ultra" will stack up against competition.
paragraph1: Android HeadlinesAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR A new leak shows off a Galaxy S27 Ultra dummy unit, offering us an early look at Samsung’s next flagship. The dummy unit has also been compared to the iPhone 18 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro, and Galaxy S26 Ultra, showing size and design differences. The redesigned camera bar on the phone could finally make magnetic accessories more practical. Samsung’s Galaxy S27 Ultra is still months away from its official debut, but we’re getting a better idea of what the company’s next flagship could look like. While renders of the device leaked months ago, folks over at Android Headlines have now built a physical dummy unit based on its exclusive CAD files, offering us a closer look at the phone’s redesigned camera bar and overall dimensions.The most noticeable change on the Galaxy S27 Ultra is its redesigned camera bar, which moves the cameras higher up on the back of the phone.
paragraph2: This leaves more room for magnetic accessories, potentially making the Galaxy S27 Ultra much more compatible with MagSafe-style chargers and battery packs.Android HeadlinesThat could be a meaningful improvement over the Galaxy S26 Ultra. While the current flagship supports magnetic accessories through compatible Qi2 cases, its large camera bump can interfere with accessories, preventing them from connecting properly. The resulting poor alignment can lead to slower charging and excessive heat.Meanwhile, the dummy Galaxy S27 Ultra unit retains the S Pen slot at the bottom, suggesting Samsung isn’t planning to ditch the stylus just yet.The phone’s dimensions also appear to remain largely unchanged.
paragraph3: The Galaxy S27 Ultra reportedly measures 163.76 x 78.25 x 7.97mm, compared to 163.6 x 78.1 x 7.
paragraph4: 9mm for the Galaxy S26 Ultra. That makes the upcoming device just a touch larger than its predecessor.Android HeadlinesThe camera bar isn’t the only design detail worth noting. Android Headlines notes that the dummy also seems to sit more steadily on a flat surface than the Galaxy S26 Ultra, although tapping the screen still causes some wobble. Since the dummy doesn’t have the final phone’s weight, it’s too early to draw conclusions about how the finished device will behave.Android HeadlinesThe redesigned camera bar also gives the Galaxy S27 Ultra a look that’s somewhat reminiscent of the iPhone 18 Pro.
paragraph5: However, Samsung isn’t the only Android manufacturer moving toward this design, which could offer practical benefits beyond aesthetics.One downside for existing Galaxy owners is that the redesigned camera arrangement will likely make Galaxy S26 Ultra cases incompatible with the new phone. While some cases with particularly large camera cutouts might still work, most will need to be replaced.Samsung is expected to unveil the Galaxy S27 series in early 2027. Until then, the dummy offers an early glimpse of what could be one of the most noticeable Galaxy Ultra redesigns in recent years, even if the rest of the phone remains largely familiar.

The resulting poor alignment can lead to slower charging and excessive heat.Meanwhile, the dummy Galaxy S27 Ultra unit retains the S Pen slot at the bottom, suggesting Samsung isn’t planning to ditch the stylus just yet.The phone’s dimensions also appear to remain largely unchanged.
bangla_paragraph3: The Galaxy S27 Ultra reportedly measures 163.76 x 78.25 x 7.97mm, compared to 163.6 x 78.1 x 7.
bangla_paragraph4: 9mm for the Galaxy S26 Ultra. That makes the upcoming device just a touch larger than its predecessor.Android HeadlinesThe camera bar isn’t the only design detail worth noting. Android Headlines notes that the dummy also seems to sit more steadily on a flat surface than the Galaxy S26 Ultra, although tapping the screen still causes some wobble. Since the dummy doesn’t have the final phone’s weight, it’s too early to draw conclusions about how the finished device will behave.Android HeadlinesThe redesigned camera bar also gives the Galaxy S27 Ultra a look that’s somewhat reminiscent of the iPhone 18 Pro.
bangla_paragraph5: However, Samsung isn’t the only Android manufacturer moving toward this design, which could offer practical benefits beyond aesthetics.One downside for existing Galaxy owners is that the redesigned camera arrangement will likely make Galaxy S26 Ultra cases incompatible with the new phone. While some cases with particularly large camera cutouts might still work, most will need to be replaced.Samsung is expected to unveil the Galaxy S27 series in early 2027. Until then, the dummy offers an early glimpse of what could be one of the most noticeable Galaxy Ultra redesigns in recent years, even if the rest of the phone remains largely familiar.

excerpt: MobiKwik Turns It Around MobiKwik minted its highest-ever quarterly profit in Q2 FY27. The record performance came on the back…
paragraph1: MobiKwik Turns It Around MobiKwik minted its highest-ever quarterly profit in Q2 FY27. The record performance came on the back of its financial services business delivering healthy revenue growth, while a tight leash on expenses helped the fintech company improve margins. Here’s a quick glance at MobiKwik’s Q2 FY27 numbers: Net profit of ₹11.8 Cr compared to a net loss of ₹28.6 Cr in Q2 FY26 Operating revenue rose 9.4% YoY to ₹295.7 Cr Total expenses declined a marginal 1.8% YoY to ₹290.9 Cr EBITDA profit stood at ₹22.7 Cr against an EBITDA loss of ₹6.4 Cr in the year ago quarter Lending Grabs The Spotlight: MobiKwik’s financial services business picked up in a big way in Q2 as the company disbursed a lot more loans and partnered with more lending partners during the quarter. At the same time, better loan book quality helped reduce expenses and improved the vertical’s gross profit. Payments’ Mixed Show: Although MobiKwik’s payments business processed much higher GMV in Q2 on a YoY basis, revenue barely grew.
paragraph2: This is because the transaction mix skewed heavily towards payments that generate lower revenue. While this helped bring down payments gateway costs, the business’ take rate took a major hit. Unlocking Operating Leverage: The quarter also saw both of MobiKwik’s core businesses expand their contribution margins, which helped offset the increased fixed expenses. Going forward, the company sees growing AI adoption in lending, engineering, customer experience, and risk management to further improve operating leverage and efficiency. As the listed fintech company looks for a way to translate higher transactions into more revenue, here is a closer look at MobiKwik’s Q2 FY27 results… RECOMMENDED FOR yOU From The Editor’s Desk 🚀 Pixxel CEO Clears Air On US Foray Cofounder and CEO Awais Ahmed has clarified that the spacetech startup remains Indian-owned, managed and controlled amid criticism over the launch of its US subsidiary, Pixxel Federal. The clarification comes after fellow spacetech startup GalaxEye highlighted its decision to operate through a single Indian entity, indirectly questioning the practice of setting up multiple entities across jurisdictions. Pixxel launched Pixxel Federal to pursue US government contracts across civilian, defence and intelligence agencies. The startup, which has raised around $195 Mn to date, also plans to go public in India in the coming years. 💼 Fireside Ventures’ Cofounder Quits Cofounder and partner Vinay Singh is stepping down from the venture capital giant after nearly a decade-long stint. The investment firm is yet to announce his successor. Singh now plans to “explore” the agentic commerce space and its implications for the future of consumption. In his decade-long tenure, Singh grew the firm into a major consumer-focused VC firm. It has so far backed more than 65 Indian startups and manages assets of around $650 Mn across four funds.
paragraph3: 📈 ESDS’ Q2 Profit Surge The AI company reported a 40.7% YoY jump in consolidated net profit to ₹31.1 Cr in Q2 FY27, while operating revenue surged 48% to ₹138.3 Cr. The company’s EBITDA rose 18.3% YoY to ₹57.8 Cr, even as its EBITDA margin narrowed to 41.8% from 52% a year ago. Total expenses increased 63.7% to ₹103.5 Cr. ESDS secured a $1.25 Bn AI cloud infrastructure deal with an Australia-based neocloud provider, with revenue expected from Q3 FY27.
paragraph4: The company is also expanding its AI infrastructure capabilities through GPU clusters and its SWARAJ Cloud platform. 📱 Record October For UPI UPI transaction volume rose 5.8% MoM to a record 25.47 Bn in October, while transaction value increased 7.4% to ₹31.53 Lakh Cr, according to NPCI data. October marked the first time UPI transactions crossed 25 Bn in volume and ₹30 Lakh Cr in value, driven partly by festive-season spending. On a YoY basis, transaction volume grew 23%, while value rose 16%. The record growth comes ahead of the proposed rollout of MDR charges on select UPI payments above ₹2,000. NPCI deferred the implementation until after Diwali, with a revised date yet to be announced. 🤖 Pronto Founder’s Physical AI Bet Pronto founder Anjali Sardana’s physical AI venture Provision Labs has acquired Mumbai-based hardware startup Basilisk for an undisclosed sum. As part of the deal, Basilisk founder Shourya Watwani will join Provision and lead its hardware efforts. Founded in 2023, Basilisk is focused on perception technologies, which help machines interpret their surroundings.
paragraph5: The startup claims to have developed a 3D hand-tracking model and built the first version of a tactile glove to capture touch-related data. This comes as Sardana recently launched Provision Labs to collect data for training and testing physical AI systems. The startup has also ramped up hiring of engineering and research teams across San Francisco, Toronto, and Bengaluru. Inc42 Markets Inc42 Startup Spotlight How Indrajaal Is Building India’s Shield Against Hostile Drones As drones become cheaper and autonomous, defending borders and critical infrastructure against them is becoming more and more harder. To fix this gap, Indrajaal is building an integrated AI platform to detect, identify and neutralise hostile drones in real time. Eyes In The Skies: Founded in 2024, Indrajaal is building a counter-drone ecosystem to secure India’s airspace. Its SkyOS platform brings together radars, radio-frequency sensors, cameras and AI to identify aerial threats and execute responses. It also offers a mobile counter-drone vehicle (Ranger), a spoofer called Repulsor and SkyCop, an interceptor drone. Hunting Hostile Drones: Indrajaal claims that its systems are deployed at installations belonging to the Indian Army, Indian Navy and agencies under the Ministry of Home Affairs. On the back of this, the startup closed FY26 with a revenue of ₹100 Cr and is targeting a top line of ₹300 Cr in FY27. The Road Ahead: Indrajaal now plans to raise ₹420 Cr in a Series A round in the near term to expand manufacturing, R&D and its footprint in the Middle East and Europe. The startup also wants to build an autonomous airspace ecosystem for aerial transport. With India’s defence tech sector projected to become a $19 Bn opportunity by 2030, here’s how Indrajaal’s AI stack is securing Indian skies… Infographic Of The Day Flipkart has been picking up stakes in Indian startups for more than a decade now.

paragraph1: Monday November 2, 2026 4:43 pm PST by Juli CloverStarting November 16, Apple will require developers to disclose whether their apps include real-world location sharing or dating features so age ratings can be assigned appropriately. Apple says the Dating and Relationships disclosure is required for apps that allow dating or relationship connections, regardless of whether that's with a real person or a virtual companion that engages in sexual or romantic content. Apps that include Dating and Relationships must have a minimum age rating of 18+, but Shared Location apps may not see a change to their minimum age rating in some regions.
paragraph2: In Brazil, apps are required to have an A16 rating for Shared Location and A18 for Dating and Relationships. Apps that may qualify for a lower age rating, such as an app that offers location sharing for parents and children, can request a rating from Brazil's Ministry of Justice and Public Security. Apps must have Shared Location and Dating and Relationships disclosures submitted through App Store Connect by January 12, 2027.

title: Apple's Q4 2026 Earnings Call Takeaways
title_bn: Apple's Q4 2026 Earnings Call Takeaways
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Apple held its earnings call for the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026 today, and it was Apple CEO John Ternus' first earnings call in his new role. He had Apple CFO Kevan Parekh on hand, and he brought in Chief Operating Officer Sabih Khan. The trio cov
paragraph1: Monday November 2, 2026 4:26 pm PST by Juli CloverApple held its earnings call for the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026 today, and it was Apple CEO John Ternus' first earnings call in his new role. He had Apple CFO Kevan Parekh on hand, and he brought in Chief Operating Officer Sabih Khan. The trio covered iPhone Duo sales, Siri AI, and increasing memory costs, among other topics. iPhone Duo After the earnings release, Ternus told Reuters that Apple isn't able to meet demand for the ‌iPhone Duo‌, and there's no word on when supply/demand balance will be reached. Ternus also acknowledged display issues and said a "very small percentage" of units have been returned. iCloud+ Ternus reiterated Apple's plans to add usage limits on server-side AI features like ‌Siri‌ AI and photo editing. Users who need more capacity will be able to purchase expanded access, but there's still no pricing information or details on the limits included with each iCloud+ plan. When asked about token consumption, Parekh said it's still early days on how much is done on-device vs. with Private Cloud Compute. The mix of [on-device and cloud Siri] is very early days, and so it's hard to predict exactly what the mix of those costs are going to look like. Obviously, on device, you know, it's very very efficient. No real costs associated with that. But on the server side, we have some inference costs. I think again, we've just recently launched it and made it available to more users. And so we're in the very very early stages of understanding the kind of mix of those costs, as well as further requirements we might have on the compute side. Siri AI Ternus said Apple has real room to expand ‌Siri‌'s capabilities over time, and that Apple wants customers to be aware of what AI agents have access to. As far as agentic capabilities, you know, we think these are promising tools for users. We just want to make sure that users are aware of what they're giving access to.
paragraph2: We want to make sure this is done in a way that protects security and privacy. So, you know, we're pushing really hard on that with Siri AI, but we're also really encouraged by the fact that Apple devices are the best places to use all forms of AI. He also said Apple's privacy focus differentiates it from other AI providers. I mean, if you think about it, so much of your personal data is on your iPhone. You know, whether it's your contacts, your communications, health data, financial data, all of that, and Siri can tap into that and help you access it in a way that's very secure and private, and that nobody else has access to. Even Apple doesn't have access to it, and so we think that is a core kind of differentiator that we're excited about, and we're going to continue to push on that. iOS and macOS Merging With the MacBook Pro gaining a touch display, an analyst asked if we're going to see a single unified operating system in the future. Ternus said Apple tries to make the best version of each and every product, while also adding features like Handoff that span across devices, but the company has no plans to make major changes. If you look at what we did last week with the MacBook Pro, we took a huge leap forward. These MacBook Pros are better in every way than the ones that came before them, and we're really proud of that. And so we don't have any fundamentally different changes that we're planning right now. Nor would we talk about it anyway. China Revenue in Greater China was up 21 percent during the quarter, which was a quarterly record. Performance was primarily driven by the iPhone and the Mac. Install Base Apple has more than 2.5 billion active devices. Memory Ternus said the memory situation is "unprecedented," and Apple expects even higher memory costs in the December quarter. Apple's price increases in June and September offset some of the pressure, as do lower costs from some non-memory components and carry-in inventory.
paragraph3: Beyond the December quarter, Apple thinks memory prices will continue to increase. Supply Constraints iPhone, iPad, and Mac were constrained in the September quarter, which Khan said was driven by demand combined with limited availability of the advanced nodes SoCs are produced on. He said constraints on advanced nodes are easing with the transition of more of the lineup to 2nm chips. iPhone iPhone revenue was $57.6 billion, up 17 percent year over year and a new September quarter record. Ternus was asked why Apple didn't release a standard iPhone 18 alongside the iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and ‌iPhone Duo‌, but he skirted the question. Mac Revenue was $10.8 billion, up from $8.7 billion, despite supply constraints. Full-year Mac revenue was $37.9 billion, up from $33.7 billion in 2025. Ternus said Apple has never sold more Macs in a fiscal year than it did in 2026. iPad ‌iPad‌ revenue was down in the quarter, coming in at $6.2 billion, down from $7 billion in the year-ago quarter. Apple said revenue was down because of supply constraints and a difficult compare against the launch of the A16 ‌iPad‌ last year. Services Services revenue hit $31.6 billion, up from $28.
paragraph4: 8 billion in the year-ago quarter, and a new all-time record. In 2026, services revenue was $123.3 billion. The App Store saw a record number of nearly a billion average weekly visitors, and Apple saw growth in the number of users who are paying for at least one service. Wearables Wearables, Home, and Accessories revenue was $8.3 billion, down 8 percent year over year. There was a difficult compare against the launch of the Apple Watch SE 3 and AirPods Pro 3 in 2025. The new Apple TV 4K, the HomePod mini, and the Apple HomeView didn't ship during the September quarter. December Quarter Apple expects revenue to grow 7 to 10 percent year over year, leading to the best quarter for revenue in Apple's history. Services revenue is expected to grow between 8 and 9 percent. Gross margin is expected to be between 45 and 46 percent, impacted by higher memory costs and costs related to the ramp of ‌Siri‌ AI. Apple expects constraints on the Mac and ‌iPad‌ in the December quarter, primarily driven by memory because demand has been higher than expected. The earnings report will be available at 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time on November 2, with new Apple CEO John Ternus and CFO Kevan Parekh to discuss the results during a 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time phone call.

The quarter included a number of August and September product releases from Apple, as well as the CEO transition from Tim Cook to John Ternus that took place on September 1. paragraph1: Monday November 2, 2026 4:02 pm PST by Juli CloverApple expects memory costs to continue to increase in the December quarter and beyond, CEO John Ternus said during today's earnings call. Ternus, COO Sabih Khan, and CFO Kevan Parekh all commented on Apple's struggle with memory. "What we're seeing with memory pricing right now is unprecedented," said Ternus. He said Apple saw higher memory costs in the September quarter, and the December quarter will be worse. "Looking beyond the December quarter, we see the pricing for memory purchases continuing to increase," he said. Apple was able to offset September costs by using memory it stockpiled at lower prices and securing lower prices on some non-memory components.
paragraph2: Apple expects the same factors to cover some of the December increases, along with price increases on iPads, Macs, and iPhones in June and September. An analyst asked if prices could increase again, but Khan, who took the question, avoided offering a direct answer. Parekh said Apple's price increases were done "reluctantly" and the company is trying to balance the impact. I think what we try to do is evaluate, and in doing that, we evaluate the unit's revenue margin, and we're really being thoughtful and deliberate at evaluating kind of the short-term and long-term considerations. And we really believe we're balancing this well. Ternus said Apple expects a declining benefit from pre-purchasing memory over time.
paragraph3: Apple's inventory more than doubled year over year to $14.5 billion, which suggests Apple is buying up memory before prices go up yet again. "As we work to improve supply, our manufacturing purchase obligations have increased by $33 billion from June to the September quarter, which you'll see in our annual filing when it comes out tomorrow," he said. Apple expects gross margin to drop from 47.9 percent in the September quarter to 45 to 46 percent in the December quarter, primarily because of higher memory costs, plus some Siri AI costs. Mac and iPad supplies will be constrained in the December quarter because of memory issues.

title: PowerUp Money Raises $10 Mn To Expand Wealth Management Services
title_bn: PowerUp Money Raises $10 Mn To Expand Wealth Management Services
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Bengaluru-based wealthtech startup PowerUp Money has raised $10 Mn (₹95 Cr) in a fresh funding round led by Flourish Ventures,…
paragraph1: SUMMARYPowerUp Money has raised $10 Mn in a fresh funding round led by Flourish Ventures, with the participation of existing investors like Peak XV, Accel, and Blume It wants to expand beyond mutual fund advisory and become a full-stack financial planning platform offering investment advisory and wealth management The startup plans to use the capital to expand its AI-led wealth management offerings, scale its managed advisory business and develop personalised financial planning solutions for Indian investors Bengaluru-based wealthtech startup PowerUp Money has raised $10 Mn (₹95 Cr) in a fresh funding round led by Flourish Ventures, with participation from existing investors Peak XV Partners, Accel, Blume Ventures, Kae Capital, 8i Ventures and DeVC. The startup plans to use the capital to expand its AI-led wealth management offerings, scale its managed advisory business and develop personalised financial planning solutions for Indian investors. “We started by making high-quality investment advice accessible to every Indian.
paragraph2: Today, AI makes it possible to deliver a much more comprehensive, wealth-manager-like experience digitally and at a fraction of traditional costs. A significant portion of this investment will go towards building an AI-powered wealth manager that brings personalised financial planning and ongoing portfolio guidance to every Indian,” PowerUp’s founder and CEO Prateek Jindal said. Jindal, who has also cofounded fintech major Uni Cards, launched PowerUp in 2025 to help customers manage their mutual fund portfolios.
paragraph3: It claims to have over 15 Lakh customers, who track mutual fund portfolios worth over ₹2.5 Lakh Cr on its platform. Its mutual fund advisory subscription, PowerUp Elite, has over 1 Lakh paid members.
paragraph4: Beyond mutual funds, the startup is now looking to combine investment advice, managed wealth services and digital advisory, becoming a full-stack financial planning platform in essence. The first step towards its new avatar has now come with the launch of its end-to-end digital wealth advisory offering, Elite Prime. The service includes an AI wealth coach and personal assistant, considers users’ financial goals, risk profiles and existing portfolios while helping them manage their portfolios and supporting their investment decisions.
paragraph5: It is also seeking to scale up its managed wealth advisory offering, Infinite, to a broader customer base. Aimed at investors seeking more hands-on financial support, Infinite combines personalised financial planning, portfolio construction, multi-asset allocation, goal-based strategies, ongoing portfolio management and dedicated adviser support. PowerUp claims that Infinite has scaled to nearly ₹500 Cr in assets under management (AUM) within around nine months of launch.

title: Quick Share will soon work directly in Android and iOS apps
title_bn: Quick Share will soon work directly in Android and iOS apps
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Google will soon let devs bake Quick Share directly into their apps.
paragraph1: Ryan Haines / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Google will launch a Quick Share SDK for Android and iOS in the first half of 2027. This will allow developers to embed peer-to-peer file sharing and Tap to Share inside of apps. With this functionality, you’ll be able to share without having to bring up the share sheet and launch the full-screen Quick Share experience. In case you didn’t know, Google recently held its Android Dev Summit.
paragraph2: In addition to offering a few details about Android 18, it also announced some news related to Quick Share. The company will be launching an SDK that will make the file-sharing tool even more convenient than it currently is.As the name suggests, Quick Share is a quick and fairly simple way to share files between two devices. While it works fine right now, it can always be better.
paragraph3: Case in point, Google will release a Quick Share SDK in the first half of 2027 for both Android and iOS apps. This will let developers embed peer-to-peer file sharing and Tap to Share inside their apps.The user benefit that comes with this integration is convenience. When you want to share something, you’ll be able to do it directly in the app.
paragraph4: That means you won’t have to go through the process of bringing up the share sheet and launching the full-screen Quick Share experience.In the images above, you can see an example of how it would work between an Android and Apple device. Starting Quick Share will bring up a bottom sheet. Users will be able to see the files being sent as a preview.
paragraph5: Google also highlights five key capabilities, including E2E encryption, low latency and maximum transfer speeds, no need for compression, offline functionality, and no costly infrastructure.

title: Next time your flight touches down, Google Maps could be there with a custom greeting
title_bn: Next time your flight touches down, Google Maps could be there with a custom greeting
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Google is prepping airport arrival messages that nudge you to try Ask Maps.
paragraph1: Akshay Gangwar / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Google Maps appears to be working on new greeting messages for when users take flights to new cities. The greetings seem designed to encourage the use of the app’s Ask Maps feature. Google’s building out support for messages in over 90 airports around the world. Have you ever landed at an airport and seen some smartly dressed valets standing around with travelers’ names printed on cards, waiting to greet them? Not all of us will ever be the sort of bigwig who gets that kind of white-glove service, but we might be able to at least pretend a little bit, thanks to a new system that’s in the works for Google Maps.You’re reading an Authority Insights story.
paragraph2: Authority Insights brings you all the latest exclusive reports, app teardowns, leaks, and in-depth tech coverage from the Android Authority team that you won’t find anywhere else.Granted, it’s nowhere near as fancy as having your own private chauffer to drive you around, but in the new version 26.45.00.1011720968 update of Google Maps for Android, we’re seeing the app prepare to deliver new airport-arrival greetings.Code<string name="AIRPORT_ARRIVAL_NOTIFICATION_TITLE">Welcome to %1$s</string> <string name="AIRPORT_ARRIVAL_NOTIFICATION_BODY">"Ask Maps to help you get into town, find a great first meal, and discover what's happening tonight."
paragraph3: </string>As you can see from those text strings, the message seems designed to steer your attention towards Ask Maps, encouraging you to take advantage of the tool in the new city you find yourself in.Code<string name="AIRPORT_ARRIVAL_ASK_MAPS_QUERY">"I just landed in %1$s! Help me get into town, recommend a great spot for my first meal, and tell me about what's happening tonight."</string>We also find this pre-formatted Ask Maps request, further lowering the bar for getting users started with giving the feature a try.So far, this appears to be largely location-based, and involves the presence of a new AirportGeofenceSyncWorker component to figure out when you’re arriving from a flight in the first place, all while working in the background. That said, we do know that Ask Maps can already tap into Gemini Personal Intelligence if you’ve got that enabled, so it may be possible to pick up further insight into your travel plans by directly accessing emails and calendar entries.
paragraph4: Google’s plans for the tool look quite broad at the moment, and we find reference to over 90 individual airports: Abu Dhabi Amsterdam Athens Atlanta Auckland Austin Bali Baltimore Bangalore Bangkok Barcelona Birmingham Boston Brisbane Bristol Calgary Cancun Charlotte Chennai Chicago Cleveland Copenhagen Dallas Delhi Denver Detroit Doha Dubai Dublin Edinburgh Fort Lauderdale Fort Myers Frankfurt Hong Kong Honolulu Houston Hyderabad Indianapolis Istanbul Johannesburg Kansas City Kitchener Kolkata Kuala Lumpur Las Vegas Lisbon London Los Angeles Madrid Malaga Manchester Manila Melbourne Mexico City Miami Minneapolis Montreal Mumbai Munich Nashville New Orleans New York Oakland Orlando Palma de Mallorca Paris Perth Philadelphia Phoenix Portland Raleigh Rome Sacramento Salt Lake City Santa Ana San Antonio San Diego San Francisco San Jose Seattle Seoul Singapore St. Louis Sydney Taipei Tampa Tel Aviv Tokyo Toronto Vancouver Warsaw Washington, D.C. excerpt: Apple today announced financial results for the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026, which corresponds to the third calendar quarter of the year. The quarter included a number of August and September product releases from Apple, as well as the CEO transiti
paragraph1: Apple today announced financial results for the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026, which corresponds to the third calendar quarter of the year. The quarter included a number of August and September product releases from Apple, as well as the CEO transition from Tim Cook to John Ternus that took place on September 1. For the quarter, Apple posted revenue of $114.5 billion and net quarterly profit of $30.7 billion, or $2.10 per diluted share, compared to revenue of $102.5 billion and net quarterly profit of $27.5 billion, or $1.85 per diluted share, in the year-ago quarter. Gross margin for the most recent quarter was 47.9 percent, compared to 47.2 percent in the year-ago quarter. Apple also declared a quarterly dividend payment of $0.27 per share, payable on November 16 to shareholders of record as of November 12. Apple set September quarter records for total revenue, iPhone revenue, and earnings per share, and an all-time record for Services revenue. For the full fiscal year, Apple recorded $478.8 billion in sales and $132.2 billion in net income, compared to previous record highs of $416.2 billion in sales and $112.0 billion in net income set in fiscal 2025.
paragraph2: "Today, Apple is proud to report a September quarter revenue record of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent from a year ago, with iPhone reaching a September quarter record and Services reaching an all-time high, capping off our best fiscal year ever," said John Ternus, Apple's CEO. "We're closing the year with our most ambitious lineup yet. That includes the iPhone Duo, the most transformational iPhone since the original, alongside iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, our most powerful iPhones yet. We also just introduced a whole new generation of hardware for the home and brought Touch to Mac for the first time. Together with the all-new Siri AI, it's an incredible lineup to carry us into the holiday season." title: Forget texting and driving, this everyday phone habit sends even more people to the ER
title_bn: Forget texting and driving, this everyday phone habit sends even more people to the ER
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Just to be clear, texting and driving is still a terrible idea.
paragraph1: Tushar Mehta / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR A new study analyzing nearly 1.8 million federal hospital records reveals the everyday phone habits linked to thousands of ER visits in the US. Losing balance while walking and using a phone topped the list, accounting for an estimated 7,760 ER visits between 2021 and 2025, with seniors most affected. Distracted driving, falling down stairs, and walking into obstacles were also among the leading causes of phone-related injuries.
paragraph2: Smartphones have become such an integral part of our lives that many of us hardly ever think twice before pulling one out of our pockets. I know I’m guilty of pulling mine out even when I’m in the middle of real-world conversations, and as it turns out, people are doing the same, albeit in far more serious situations.Phones are convenient, though they aren’t necessarily harmless, and a new study is reiterating how glancing at your phone at the wrong moment could land you in the emergency room (ER).The new study, which was published by Calderon Law Firm, examined roughly 1.
paragraph3: 8 million federal hospital records to find out which “everyday activities” caused the most phone-related injuries, and the results are truly surprising. You’d have presumed that distracted driving would be the biggest culprit, but it turns out doing something as simple as walking with your phone out has the highest chance of landing you in the ER.According to the study, using your phone while walking around might be the most dangerous phone habit in the US. Losing balance while walking and using a phone accounted for roughly 7,760 ER visits between 2021 and 2025, with those 65 and older being the most affected group, and head fractures being the most frequently injured body part and injury type.
paragraph4: Younger people aren’t exactly safe from the dangers of walking either. Falling down the stairs, walking into poles, walls, and doors, falling on curbs & uneven sidewalks, missing a step on the stairs, and even falling over rugs, cords & pets were all among the leading causes of phone-related ER visits in the US. ActivitySettingEstimated ER visits (US, 2021–2025)Share of all phone-use injuries (2021–2025)Most-injured body partMost common injuryWho gets hurt mostLosing your balance while walkingOn foot7,76018%HeadFractureSeniors (65+)Answering or picking up the phone while drivingBehind the wheel4,85011%HeadBruise or scrapeAdults (25–44)Looking at the phone while drivingBehind the wheel4,65011%HeadBruise or scrapeAdults (25–44)Falling down the stairsOn the stairs4,0009%AnkleFractureMiddle-aged (45–64)Walking into poles, walls & doorsOn foot3,1457%HeadHead injury (incl. concussion)Adults (25–44)Falling on curbs & uneven sidewalksOn foot3,0207%AnkleFractureAdults (25–44)Riding a bikeOn wheels2,3205%HeadBruise or scrapeAdults (25–44)Riding e-bikes & scootersOn wheels1,9805%FaceFractureAdults (25–44)Missing a step on the stairsOn the stairs1,9505%AnkleSprain or strainMiddle-aged (45–64)Falling over rugs, cords & petsOn foot1,8404%FaceFractureSeniors (65+) Elsewhere, the report strangely groups answering a phone call and picking up a dropped phone into the same category.
paragraph5: The latter is clearly more dangerous, especially considering that answering calls can be managed without physically handling your phone. That’s not to say that hands-free calling is completely safe, but grouping it with the physical act of picking up a dropped phone while driving doesn’t make much sense.Regardless, the report does make a convincing case for being more mindful of when and where we use our phones. Distracted driving, of course, gets attention, but even seemingly harmless habits like checking your phone while walking or climbing the stairs can have serious consequences.

title: Sneak peek: Google app is preparing a big change for its bottom bar
title_bn: গুগল অ্যাপটি তার নীচের বারে বড় পরিবর্তন আনতে যাচ্ছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Google may swap out the Google app's Activity tab for something new.
paragraph1: Edgar Cervantes / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Google is working on a “You” tab that could replace the “Activity” tab in the Google app. In addition to various history groups, the new tab would include your profile picture, email, and a drop-down icon for the account switcher. A pinning feature for your AI conversations could also be on the way. Google just recently announced redesigns for the Messages, Contacts, and Phone apps. As those redesigns roll out, the company is quietly toiling away on another change, this time targeting the Google app. This update could shake up the tab bar, replacing one of the tabs with something new.You’re reading an Authority Insights story.
paragraph2: Authority Insights brings you all the latest exclusive reports, app teardowns, leaks, and in-depth tech coverage from the Android Authority team that you won’t find anywhere else.The current version of the Google app has four tabs located at the bottom of the screen. This tab bar includes Home, Search, Notifications, and Activity. The Activity tab is where you go if you want to check on your AI Mode history or normal search history. This page also includes sections for Saved items, Collections, Recent Songs Searches, and Lens Searches.While digging into version 17.72.
paragraph3: 13.sa.arm64 of the Google app, we found that Google is working on a UI change. This change would introduce a new “You” tab, and it would replace the Activity tab. In the screenshots below, you can see what this new You tab brings to the table.First and foremost, your profile picture is featured prominently at the top of the page. The header area also includes your email address and a drop-down icon.
paragraph4: You’ll use this drop-down icon to access the account switcher, which shows at the bottom of the screen. In the top right corner, you’ll also find a gear icon to open the Google app settings page.Along with these details, there are sections for Saves & collections, Lens searches, and Song searches. For whatever reason, AI mode history and regular search history are missing on this page. We suspect these sections are likely missing because the You tab is still a work in progress.AssembleDebug / Android AuthoritySomething else we noticed during our investigation is that the tech giant is working on a pinning feature for your AI Mode conversations. Currently, if you access your AI Mode search history from the sidebar in the Google Home screen, long pressing on a thread/conversation in “Recent” section shows the following options: Add to notebook, Share, and Delete.
paragraph5: We found strings of code suggesting a new pin/unpin option could be added to this menu in the future.Code<string name="googleapp_aim_threads_pin_text">Pin</string> <string name="googleapp_aim_threads_unpin_text">Unpin</string>Additionally, we found a few plural strings, which hint that you may be able to select multiple chats to pin/unpin at the same time.Code<plurals name="assistant_robin_threads_ia_bulk_pinned_confirmation"> <item quantity="one">%1$d chat pinned</item> <item quantity="other">%1$d chats pinned</item> </plurals> ⚠️ An APK teardown helps predict features that may arrive on a service in the future based on work-in-progress code. bangla_paragraph2: কর্তৃপক্ষ অন্তর্দৃষ্টি আপনাকে অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষের দল থেকে সর্বশেষতম একচেটিয়া প্রতিবেদন, অ্যাপ্লিকেশন টিয়ারডাউন, ফাঁস এবং গভীর প্রযুক্তিগত কভারেজ নিয়ে আসে যা আপনি অন্য কোথাও পাবেন না। গুগল অ্যাপ্লিকেশনের বর্তমান সংস্করণে স্ক্রিনের নীচে অবস্থিত চারটি ট্যাব রয়েছে। এই ট্যাবি বারে হোম, অনুসন্ধান, বিজ্ঞপ্তি এবং ক্রিয়াকলাপ অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে। আপনি যদি আপনার এআই মোড ইতিহাস বা সাধারণ অনুসন্ধানের ইতিহাস পরীক্ষা করতে চান তবে ক্রিয়াকাণ্ডের ট্য্যাবটি যেখানে আপনি যান। এই পৃষ্ঠায় সংরক্ষিত আইটেম, সংগ্রহ,  এর জন্য বিভাগগুলিও অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে
bangla_paragraph3: 13.sa.arm64 গুগল অ্যাপ্লিকেশন, আমরা দেখেছি যে গুগলের একটি ইউআই পরিবর্তন কাজ করছে। এই পরিবর্তন একটি নতুন You ট্যাব চালু করবে, এবং এটি কার্যকলাপ ট্যাবি প্রতিস্থাপন করবে। নীচের স্ক্রিনশটগুলিতে, আপনি এই নতুন আপনি ট্য্যাব টেবিলে কি এনেছে দেখতে পারেন। প্রথম এবং সর্বাগ্রে, আপনার প্রোফাইল ছবিটি পৃষ্ঠার শীর্ষে বিশিষ্টভাবে বৈশিষ্ট্যযুক্ত। শিরোনাম এলাকায় আপনার ইমেল ঠিকানা এবং একটি ড্রপ-ডাউন আইকন অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph4: আপনি এই ড্রপ-ডাউন আইকনটি ব্যবহার করে অ্যাকাউন্ট সুইচারের অ্যাক্সেস পাবেন, যা স্ক্রিনের নীচে প্রদর্শিত হয়। উপরের ডানদিকে, আপনি গুগল অ্যাপ্লিকেশন সেটিংস পৃষ্ঠা খুলতে একটি গিয়ার আইকোনও পাবেন। এই বিবরণগুলির সাথে, সংরক্ষণ এবং সংগ্রহ, লেন্স অনুসন্ধান এবং গান অনুসন্ধানের জন্য বিভাগ রয়েছে। যে কোনও কারণে, এআই মোডের ইতিহাস এবং নিয়মিত অনুসন্ধানের ইতিহাস এই পৃষ্ঠায় অনুপস্থিত। আমরা সন্দেহ করি যে এই বিভাগগুলি সম্ভবত অনুপସ୍ଥିତ কারণ আপনি ট্যাবটি এখনও একটি অগ্রগতিশীল কাজ।AssembleDebug / An

title: Clinics On Cloud Bags ₹120 Cr To Take Its Health ATMs Global
title_bn: ক্লিনিকগুলি মেঘের ব্যাগে ₹120 কোটি টাকা নিয়ে যাবে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Health tech startup Clinics On Cloud has raised ₹120 Cr (around $12.5 Mn) in its Series A funding round from…
paragraph1: SUMMARYThe startup plans to use the funds to bolster AI capabilities, scale R&D, strengthen its manufacturing capacity and expand global footprint Having raised the funds at a valuation of ₹600 Cr, Clinics On Cloud now plans to use UAE as a base for international expansion across Africa, the US and Southeast Asia Founded in 2018, Clinics On Cloud manufactures and deploys health ATMs, portable box clinics and mobile medical units that deliver preventive health checkups and telemedicine consultations Health tech startup Clinics On Cloud has raised ₹120 Cr (around $12.5 Mn) in its Series A funding round from Model42, the medtech-focused investment arm of UAE-based backer Enlightened Minds Investments. The Pune-based startup raised the fresh funds at a valuation of ₹600 Cr ($63.3 Mn) In a statement, the startup said that it plans to utilise the fresh capital to bolster its AI-led healthcare capabilities, expand research and development (R&D), and accelerate the growth of its micro-clinic ecosystem.
paragraph2: A chunk of the funding will also be used to strengthen its manufacturing capacity, scale strategic partnerships with healthcare providers and expand global footprint. “For eight years, we have built Clinics On Cloud with a simple belief that quality healthcare should never depend on someone’s pincode. This investment gives us the opportunity to take that vision global…,” said Clinics On Cloud cofounder and CEO Abhay Agarwal. Founded in 2018 by Abhay and Manashrri Agarwal, Clinics On Cloud manufactures and deploys AI-powered “health ATMs”, portable box clinics and mobile medical units that deliver point-of-care preventive health checkups and telemedicine consultations.
paragraph3: These solutions enable hospitals and government agencies to set up temporary micro-clinics. It claims to have so far seen more than 3,500 deployments across 200 cities in India and seven other countries. Having screened more than 1.2 Cr patients so far, the startup claims to cater to the Indian Army, Navy and the Border Security Force (BSF).
paragraph4: The Pune-based startup now plans to position UAE as its global expansion hub, with an eye on exploring new markets across Africa, the US and Southeast Asia. The fundraise comes amid growing investor interest in the healthtech sector, which is seeing renewed funding activity on the back of AI adoption. In September this year, smart ring maker Ultrahuman raised $70 Mn to fuel its integrated healthtech playbook. In July, another AI-powered healthtech startup CARPL.
paragraph5: ai also bagged $10 Mn in its Series A funding round led by International Finance Corporation (IFC). In the same month, actor Kunal Kapoor banded together with crowdfunding platform Ketto’s cofounders Varun Sheth and Zaheer Adenwala to launch healthtech startup MetaGO. At the heart of all this is the homegrown healthtech market, which is projected to become a $37 Bn opportunity by 2030.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসারএই স্টার্টআপটি এআই ক্ষমতা বাড়াতে, গবেষণা ও উন্নয়নকে স্কেল করতে, তার উত্পাদন ক্ষমতা জোরদার করতে এবং বিশ্বব্যাপী পদচিহ্ন প্রসারিত করতে তহবিল ব্যবহার করার পরিকল্পনা করেছে। 600 কোটি টাকার মূল্যায়নে তহবিলে যোগদানের পর, ক্লিনিকস অন ক্লাউড এখন আফ্রিকা, মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্র এবং দক্ষিণ-পূর্ব এশিয়া জুড়ে আন্তর্জাতিক সম্প্রসারণের জন্য সংযুক্ত আরব আমিরাতকে একটি ভিত্তি হিসাবে ব্যবহার করার পরিকল্পনার কথা ভাবছে।
bangla_paragraph2: এই তহবিলের একটি অংশও এর উৎপাদন ক্ষমতা জোরদার করতে, স্বাস্থ্যসেবা প্রদানকারীদের সাথে কৌশলগত অংশীদারিত্ব বাড়াতে এবং বিশ্বব্যাপী ছাপ প্রসারিত করতে ব্যবহার করা হবে। আট বছর ধরে, আমরা ক্লিনিকস অন ক্লাউডকে এমন একটি সহজ বিশ্বাসের সাথে তৈরি করেছি যে মানসম্পন্ন স্বাস্থ্যসেবার কখনই কারও পিনকোডের উপর নির্ভর করা উচিত নয়। এই বিনিয়োগ আমাদের সেই দৃষ্টিভঙ্গিকে বিশ্বব্যাপি গ্রহণের সুযোগ দেয়, "ক্লিনিক্স অন ক্লাউন সহ-প্রতিষ্ঠাতা এবং প্রধান নির্বাহী কর্মকর্তা অভয় আগরওয়াল বলেছেন। ২০১৮ সালে অভয় এবং মানাশ্রী আগরওয়ালে প্রতিষ্ঠিত, ক্লিনিক্স অন ক্লৌড ম্যানুফ্যাকচার
bangla_paragraph3: এই সমাধানগুলি হাসপাতাল এবং সরকারী সংস্থাগুলিকে অস্থায়ী মাইক্রো-ক্লিনিক স্থাপন করতে সক্ষম করে। এটি দাবি করে যে এটি এখন পর্যন্ত ভারতের ২০০ টি শহর এবং অন্যান্য সাতটি দেশে ৩৫০০ টিরও বেশি মোতায়েন দেখেছে। এখন পর্যন্ত ১.২ কোটি রোগীর বেশি স্ক্রিনিং করার পরে, স্টার্টআপটি দাবি করে ভারতীয় সেনাবাহিনী, নৌবাহিনী এবং সীমান্ত সুরক্ষা বাহিনী (বিএসএফ) কে সরবরাহ করতে।
bangla_paragraph4: পুনে ভিত্তিক স্টার্টআপটি এখন সংযুক্ত আরব আমিরাতকে তার বৈশ্বিক সম্প্রসারণ কেন্দ্র হিসাবে অবস্থান করার পরিকল্পনা করেছে, আফ্রিকা, মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্র এবং দক্ষিণ-পূর্ব এশিয়ার নতুন বাজারগুলি অন্বেষণের লক্ষ্যে। এই তহবিল সংগ্রহ স্বাস্থ্য প্রযুক্তি খাতে বিনিয়োগকারীদের ক্রমবর্ধমান আগ্রহের মধ্যে আসে, যা এআই গ্রহণের পিছনে পুনর্নবীকরণ তহবিলে কার্যকলাপ দেখছে। এই বছরের সেপ্টেম্বরে, স্মার্ট রিং প্রস্তুতকারক আল্ট্রাহুম্যান তার সংহত স্বাস্থ্য প্রযুক্তি প্লেবুককে চালিত করার জন্য 70 মিলিয়ন ডলার সংগ্রহ করেছে। জুলাইয়ে, আরেকটি এআই-চালিত স্বাস্থ্য প্রযুক্তি স্টার্ট আপ কারপল।
bangla_paragraph5: আইএফসির নেতৃত্বে আইএফও তার সিরিজ এ ফান্ডিং রাউন্ডে ১০ মিলিয়ন ডলার সংগ্রহ করেছে। একই মাসে অভিনেতা কুনাল কাপুর ক্রাউডফান্ডিং প্ল্যাটফর্ম কেটো'র সহ-প্রতিষ্ঠাতা বরুণ শেঠ এবং জাহির আদনওয়ালার সাথে মিলে স্বাস্থ্য প্রযুক্তি স্টার্টআপ মেটাজিও চালু করেছেন। এর কেন্দ্রবিন্দুতে হোমগ্রোনেড হেলথটেক মার্কেট রয়েছে, যা ২০৩০ সালের মধ্যে ৩৭ বিলিয়ন ডলারের সুযোগে পরিণত হবে বলে অনুমান করা হচ্ছে।

title: Don’t look now, but these Google apps are getting a facelift
title_bn: এখন দেখবেন না, কিন্তু গুগলের এই অ্যাপগুলোতে নতুন করে চেহারা তৈরি হচ্ছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: These Google apps are going to look a little different soon.
paragraph1: Edgar Cervantes / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Google has rolled out refreshed icons for three apps: Google Contacts, Google Messages, and Phone by Google. These icons now feature gradient coloring and updated curvature. They are designed to appear sharper and clearer on your home screen.
paragraph2: If you follow our coverage, then you know that Google was preparing a redesign for the Messages app icon. The update would bring the app more in line with the company’s other refreshed icons. However, it turns out that the Messages app won’t be the only one getting a new look.
paragraph3: After we gave you an early look at the new Google Messages icon, the tech giant has now made it official. In a blog post, Google reveals that the redesign will start rolling out today. Along with the Messages app, the Google Contacts and Phone by Google apps are getting the same treatment.
paragraph4: The refresh adds gradient coloring to the icons and gives the designs a more minimalist look. These icons also feature updated curvature, so they are more rounded than before. According to Google, the purpose of the facelift is to make the icons appear “sharper and clearer on your home screen.
paragraph5: ”While these apps are getting updated icons, you can still expect the same experience. No changes have been made to the functionality of these apps. As the update is rolling out now, you should see the change on your phone soon.

title: Google could soon let you put your kids’ Gemini chats on a timer
title_bn: গুগল শীঘ্রই আপনার বাচ্চাদের  জেমিনি চ্যাট টাইমারে রাখতে পারে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Your kids don't need unlimited AI time, if any.
paragraph1: Edgar Cervantes / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Google appears to be working on a feature that would let parents set daily Gemini usage limits for supervised accounts. Once children reach their daily limit, Gemini could display a lockout screen telling them when they can use the assistant again. It’s unclear whether the limits will apply only to the Gemini app or across other Gemini experiences, such as the overlay and Google Messages. Did you know Google already lets you decide whether your children can use Gemini or not? As a parent, you have the option, via the Family Link app, to either let your kids experiment with generative AI. This approach, however, is all or nothing. You either give them access or block it completely.
paragraph2: Currently, there’s no middle ground, and it looks like Google wants to change that.The tech giant appears to be working on a functionality that would let parents set daily usage limits for Gemini.You’re reading an Authority Insights story. Authority Insights brings you all the latest exclusive reports, app teardowns, leaks, and in-depth tech coverage from the Android Authority team that you won’t find anywhere else.We spotted the development in the Google app’s latest version 17.72.13.
paragraph3: sa.arm64 build, with several new strings pointing to the tech giant working on daily Gemini time restrictions for supervised accounts. All of these strings, for reference, are written from the perspective of the child’s device. They highlight what a supervised account holder will see on their phone.Should kids have access to AI assistants like Gemini?1 votesOne of the strings reads, “Your parent set a daily time limit for Gemini,” which will likely appear as a snackbar notification informing a child that their parents have imposed a usage limit for Gemini. Similarly, “Your daily Gemini time limit changed,” will pop up when a parent makes an adjustment to the allotted time.
paragraph4: More importantly, the new strings also reveal what happens when that allotted time runs out.Code<string name="assistant_robin_time_limit_lockout_body">Gemini will be ready again at %1$s.</string> <string name="assistant_robin_time_limit_lockout_body_unknown_reset_time">Gemini will be ready again when your daily limit resets.</string> <string name="assistant_robin_time_limit_lockout_close_app_button">Close app</string> <string name="assistant_robin_time_limit_lockout_title">"You've reached your daily limit for Gemini"</string> If and when a child uses up all the allotted Gemini time, the app will tell them about the daily limit and when they’ll be able to start using Gemini again. Likely, the prompt would also offer a dedicated Close app button on the app lockout screen.Plus, similar to the allotment adjustment notification, Google has also added an in-app message that reads, “Your daily Gemini time limit was turned off,” which will likely show up when a parent removes the time restriction.Note that the strings don’t spell out whether the timer is limited to the dedicated Gemini app or the overall Gemini experience.
paragraph5: After all, Gemini isn’t restricted to the standalone app. It can also be accessed via the Gemini overlay, and even through integrations in other apps like Google Messages.What the experience will look like on the parents’ side also remains unclear for now. title: Tachyum, developer of heavily-delayed universal Prodigy processor, voluntarily files for bankruptcy
title_bn: ট্যাচিউম, ব্যাপক বিলম্বিত সার্বজনীন প্রোডিজি প্রসেসর এর ডেভেলপার, স্বেচ্ছায় দেউলিয়া হয়ে গেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Tachyum files for bankruptcy, the court in Bratislava initiates bankruptcy proceedings.
paragraph1: (Image credit: Tachyum) Recent updates Update 11/2/2026 3:00 PM ET: As it turns out, the ultimate parent company and holder of all Tachyum intellectual property is Cayman Islands-based Tachyum Ltd., which controls U.S.-based Tachyum Inc., which in turn controls Slovakia-based Tachyum s.
paragraph2: r.o. that is responsible for the lion’s share of Tachyum’s development of the Prodigy universal processor. This means that while Tachyum Inc. and Tachyum s.
paragraph3: r.o. can be declared insolvent and liquidated, Tachyum Ltd. can continue operations, establish new entities and continue developing Prodigy.However, the Cayman Islands company holding Prodigy-related patents is itself the target of liquidation proceedings.
paragraph4: Therefore, the Slovak subsidiary’s bankruptcy cannot necessarily protect Prodigy’s intellectual property from creditors. If Tachyum Ltd. is liquidated, the control over the Prodigy patents could pass to court-appointed liquidators, who could sell them to repay creditors. In any case, this could be the end of the road for Tachyum.

title: Windows 11 now lets you access Android apps straight from Search
title_bn: উইন্ডোজ ১১ এখন আপনাকে সরাসরি অনুসন্ধান থেকে অ্যান্ড্রয়েড অ্যাপ্লিকেশন অ্যাক্সেস করতে দেয়
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Opening your Android phone apps on Windows 11 is now less of a chore.
paragraph1: Dhruv Bhutani / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Microsoft has rolled out a new Insider Experimental Preview Build that lets you open apps from your Android phone using Windows 11’s taskbar Search. Opening an app from Search launches the app on your phone and mirrors it on your PC through Phone Link. The feature works with select Samsung, HONOR, OPPO, ASUS, vivo, Xiaomi, iQOO, and Realme phones. Microsoft has also made it so that you can call or text and access phone actions from Search. Microsoft wants to bring Windows 11 and Android closer together.
paragraph2: This year, the company has worked on a number of changes, like adding a new Mobile devices tile and improving clipboard history syncing between PC and phone. Taking another step in that direction, Microsoft has made opening phone apps on PCs much more convenient.This weekend, Microsoft released its latest Insider Experimental Preview Build (version 26340.9843). The change notes state that you can now use the taskbar Search to call or text a friend and access phone actions, like Do Not Disturb.
paragraph3: In the example Microsoft shared, a user types “dnd phone” into Search to bring up an action to “Turn on do not disturb.” The tech giant says this feature is available now for Android, and iPhone support will come early next year.Not mentioned in these change notes is the ability to use Search to open Android apps. Spotted by Windows Latest, a user can type the name of the app they want to open into Search. That app will appear in the results with “Mobile app” located right under the name.
paragraph4: Clicking on the option launches the app on your phone and mirrors it on your PC through Phone Link.While you could already open supported Android apps through Phone Link, this change streamlines the process. Previously, you had to open the Phone Link app, open the app, and then mirror it. This way, you just have to type the name of the app in Search and click Open.Unfortunately, this change won’t be available for all Android owners.
paragraph5: You’ll need to have a supported phone, which includes select Samsung, HONOR, OPPO, ASUS, vivo, Xiaomi, iQOO, and Realme phones. The device will also need to be running on Android 11 or later. You can check out the full list of supported devices on Microsoft’s support page.
